notes: Inbound SMB fintech. Early-stage payments/analytics startup (51-200 employees). Started with self-serve hosted API trial — embedding similarity for transaction grouping is primary POC. Security is top of mind: explicitly asked for SOC2 report, SSO/SAML + SCIM support, and KMS options. Latency target: p95 < 300ms for embeddings and < 500ms for reranking flows. Model preference: high-quality open models; willing to try Redwood-curated defaults.
